prompt: Edit image 1 and change only the drawing in Maria's hands. Keep Maria, MACA, the room, the camera, the light and every pose exactly as they are in image 1: Maria on the left smiling up at MACA and holding a sheet of paper in both hands in front of her at waist height facing the camera, MACA on the right with her open palm extended toward Maria. The paper in Maria's hands carries exactly the drawing of image 3: Maria's crayon drawing on cream paper: on the left a girl with brown hair, a thin yellow headband and a pink pinafore dress; in the middle a small tan dog with a blue checked blanket draped over its back; on the right a robot drawn upright, a round white head with a teal visor band and two blue eyes, square shoulders, a pink chest with a row of five coloured chest lights and orange joints; green zigzag grass along the bottom, with a big sunburst of yellow and orange crayon glow scribbles drawn all around the whole robot, thickest around its pink chest, crossing its arms and legs and running off the top, right and bottom edges of the paper, while the girl and the dog stay clear of it. Image 3 is the artwork alone, cropped to the paper: it fills a wide landscape sheet of cream paper that Maria holds horizontally, the grass along the bottom edge, the girl at the left end and the robot at the right end, facing the camera. Nothing else changes; no new people, no paper on MACA's chest. Image 1 is the authority for render style, lens, lighting, room, furniture and colour: keep its finished 3D animated film look exactly, as if this were another frame of the same shot. Image 2 is a painted character sheet used only for identity (faces, hair, wardrobe colours); never copy its painted style, its plain background or its poses. Identity, from image 2: Maria is a small girl with black bangs, a thin yellow headband, a side ponytail with a pink scrunchie, a pink overall outfit over a light-blue collared shirt and purple boots. The crayon boy has tousled ginger-blond hair and a green T-shirt with a small dinosaur. The braids girl has two dark braids and olive overalls over a cream shirt. The jersey boy has short brown hair and a white shirt with navy trim. MACA is a tall robot with a white riveted helmet, a glowing blue face screen with two smiling eyes, a pink chest plate with a small dark inset screen and an orange hip plate. Chico is a small tan-and-white chihuahua with a pink collar. One instance of each character only. Output one 16:9 full-colour production frame, 1280x720, no text, no sketch lines.
